title: Custom Operations Software for a Multi-Location Golf Cart Dealership
summary: A family office's newly acquired dealership went from manual, disconnected tracking to one connected system across every location.

image.alt: An Etto Leisure Carts golf cart on a waterfront road

challenge: Hoplite Capital is a single-family office that acquired Etto Leisure Carts, a high-end golf cart dealership operating across multiple locations.
The business had no centralized tracking — inventory, sales, repairs, quotes and invoices were all manual and disconnected.
solution: We built comprehensive custom work software using Airtable, Make.com, a Shopmonkey integration and QuickBooks.
Now they have real-time visibility across all operations, with automated workflows for quotes, invoicing, inventory, sales, service tickets and team management.

gallery.alt: The Etto Live location audit in the custom operations software

title: One Platform That Runs an Entire Ice Cream Business
summary: Expensive, disconnected tools replaced by one owned system: orders, kitchen, training, wholesale and inventory, plus an AI email agent.

image.alt: A freezer stacked with Happy Endings ice cream

challenge: Happy Endings was juggling multiple expensive software tools that didn't talk to each other — and losing orders every week.
solution: We built an AI email agent and an entire internal system: orders, kitchen management, employee training, traceability and tracking, wholesale ordering and inventory. One platform now runs the whole business.
We eliminated their external software costs, and they plan to use the system as an asset when they sell the business.

gallery.alt: The Happy Endings wholesale customer portal

title: Investor Tracking and Document Management for a $20M Debt Round
summary: Spreadsheets and manual document sends replaced with one platform tracking every investor through the raise.
challenge: SunMed Growers was raising a $20M debt round and needed a way to track investors, manage documents and streamline the entire capital raise.
They were juggling spreadsheets, email threads and manual document sends — a nightmare at that scale.
solution: We built a custom tracker and document sending platform that centralized investor communications and automated document distribution.
Their team got real-time visibility into the status of every investor in the pipeline.

title: A RAG-Powered Slack Bot for 50+ Mortgage Underwriters
summary: A national mortgage lender's underwriters now get answers from internal documents in seconds instead of hours.
challenge: Neighbors Bank is a national mortgage lender with 50+ underwriters handling USDA, FHA, VA and conventional loans.
Their team was wasting hours searching shared drives and documents, with manual escalations by email and manager tags.
solution: We built a custom Slack bot using RAG: underwriters ask questions in plain English and get instant answers from internal documents.
Automated escalations and custom commands handle the advanced workflows.

title: An Appointment-Setting Agent for a Custom Fence Company
summary: An AI agent answers every quote request instantly, qualifies it and books the estimate.
challenge: Mike's Fences builds custom wood fences, but Mike was missing leads because he couldn't respond fast enough — customers would submit quote requests and wait days for a callback.
solution: We built a custom appointment-setting agent that responds immediately, qualifies the lead, gathers project details and schedules estimates automatically.
Now Mike focuses on building fences, not playing phone tag.

title: A Healthcare App That Replaced Manual Booking and Scheduling
summary: Patients book directly, providers manage their availability, and confirmations and reminders run on their own.
challenge: Noble TeleHealth's patients and providers were stuck in a clunky manual booking process that led to missed appointments, double-bookings and hours of admin overhead.
solution: We built a custom healthcare application that handles the entire scheduling flow: patients book directly, providers manage availability, and the system sends confirmations and reminders automatically.

title: A Custom CRM for a Growing Internet Service Provider
summary: Spreadsheets and email threads replaced with one CRM covering the full customer lifecycle.
challenge: Flume Internet was managing its entire customer pipeline and operations manually — spreadsheets, email threads and disconnected tools.
solution: We built a custom CRM on Airtable and n8n that handles the full customer lifecycle: lead tracking, pipeline management, onboarding, support tickets and automated follow-ups.
Everything is connected, and nothing falls through the cracks.

title: Unstack: Our AI-Powered Business Operations Platform
summary: A productized version of the systems we build for clients, giving every organization its own AI-enabled workspace.
challenge: Unstack is a SaaS product built and operated by Harmon Digital: an AI-powered business operations platform that gives each organization its own workspace, complete with AI agents, workflow automation and custom tools.
solution: We built it from the ground up as a productized version of the systems we build for clients.
Organizations get their own subdomain and a fully managed, AI-enabled environment to run their operations.
